title: I created a stock website and i'm looking for people to demo it for free! ($50 in API's per month)
author: JellyfishRegular5495
selftext: I created a website site that acceses over 10 different API's to give live updates on news, shows trends, pre and post market moves, it has a whole section dedicated to trump and the articles and how it will influence stocks. It also has an entire section on penny stocks with analysis and live predictions. Let me know if you would want to demo!

comments.author: 3_years_to_retire
comments.body: Does it have a live market stream for level 2 data? I was trying to build one but I cant find anyone that will give live market data pipe for my custom server that doesn't cost a ridiculous amount per month. Ideally I just want to use AI to analyze live market data and spit out a few stocks worth my consideration before trading.

replies.author: JellyfishRegular5495
replies.body: It currently does not have level 2 data, I didn’t even consider it. I’ll have to do some research and get back to you about that. The website though, does use ai to spit out stocks that have positive trends and patterns. It doesn’t make assumptions, and it uses real trends to recommend what to buy.

replies.author: 3_years_to_retire
replies.body: I have been looking, I was trying to find a site to provide it i started preparing a python shell on my desktop for it. But all the sites that provide level 2 market data api wants a lot more money than I feel comfortable paying for a system I am just trying out. I basically want to be able to talk or chat with my AI about what I want and it query the market for me with live real time data for me to analyze before trading on

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: If you tell me more details about what you need I can get it setup for you

replies.author: 3_years_to_retire
replies.body: I don't trade all the time, but I started using AI to ask questions about some stocks or to filter stocks and I have noticed that it's not always giving live updates. When I asked it why it gave me an old figure it said that it doesnt have a live tie in to the market that it scans websites and spits out what it believes to be current or accurate information. So I was looking for a way to pipe in a direct line to the market that it can query.

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: Ten APIs sounds impressive until you realise most of them are just repackaging the same delayed data, so the real question is what your site does that a free screener doesn't. The Trump-article-to-stock angle is fun but that's narrative trading, not edge, and penny stock 'live predictions' is where I'd be most careful about what you're actually claiming. If you want a benchmark for how a real data page should read, API (Agora Inc) is at 55/100 on trademates.co, rated HOLD with a HIGH risk class given its micro-cap size, thin volume, negative free cash flow and Shanghai HQ exposure. No verified catalyst on it right now, and the model plan would scale in at 4.00 with a stop at 3.10, so that's the kind of sober framing I'd want to see on your site instead of hype.

replies.author: JellyfishRegular5495
replies.body: That’s a fair point but nothing on the website is assumptions. I shouldn’t say they are predictions, rather the data is analyzed and within the API’s it searches for combined positive data and trend patterns.

comments.body:
